gold: Short-coupled polymorphic ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation (SC-PMVT/VF) variant of idiopathic ventricular fibrillation

selector.rationale: Repetitive monomorphic premature ventricular complexes with short-coupling interval and polymorphic ventricular tachycardia are characteristic of CPVT, supported by multiple evidence points and no strong contradictions.

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy (ARVC)
rejected.why: Normal cardiac function and structure on echocardiography contradict ARVC, which typically shows right ventricular dysfunction.

rejected.label: Ventricular Fibrillation
rejected.why: While ventricular fibrillation is mentioned, it is a consequence rather than a primary diagnosis, and CPVT better explains the underlying condition.
